How it works

From photo to finished painting in four steps.

The same simple flow on iPhone and iPad. Paint anywhere, finish whenever you like.

  1. 1

    Pick a photo

    Choose any photo you love from your library, or start with a free sample.

  2. 2

    Choose your detail

    Easy, Normal, Hard or Expert: from big calm regions to maximum detail.

  3. 3

    Tap to paint

    Pick a color, tap a region. Undo, redo and find your next region anytime.

  4. 4

    Show it off

    Export your finished painting and share what you made.

Features

Room to relax. Detail when you want it.

Expert-level paintings shine on iPad, and every painting is saved so you can pick it up again.

  • Your Photo, Your Detail

    Choose from four difficulty levels, from big calm regions that are fast and relaxing to maximum detail for advanced paintings.

  • Tap to Paint

    Fill in regions with a tap, undo or redo anytime, and highlight matching areas so you always know where to go next.

  • Never Lose Your Place

    A locate button jumps to the next region to paint, so you can always find where to go next.

  • Make Every Color Yours

    Tap any palette color to change what it paints. Regions you already filled update right away.

  • Save Every Painting

    Your library keeps every painting in progress on your device, so you can finish anytime.

  • Handled with Care

    Your selected photo is uploaded only for conversion and deleted after a successful result. Failed uploads are scheduled for deletion within seven days. No account required.
